I received a package on August 6th.  The name was Martina Rodriguez and the address is 1000 State Street in Calumet City Illinois.  This is the ad of Gateway Warehouse Corporation.  Inside was a lotion named Unicorn Fruit.  I did order this item.  I am calling Gateway tomorrow to inform them.  This person has my address.  Please advise.

I received an unsolicited package from this address by USPS Ground Advantage. The item that I received was a "panoramic rearview mirror." I have received several other unsolicited packages in the last few months, but not from this return address.

I saw a truck I was interested in purchasing online. Www.joekellyautosales.com I contacted the business and asked for photos of the truck I was interested in. I liked it and made an offer. My offer was accepted I told the salesman it would take me a few days to get the money together he said no problem just send a photo copy of my drivers license. I told him I was driving and that if he sent me the paperwork I would send it back. He said he would ship the vehicle to my address at no extra cost. I told him my street was being resurfaced and that I could meet them at my local police department. Since then I haven’t been able to contact them. This morning 8/8/26 I saw the exact same photos of the trucks I was looking at on a different website for a dealership in PA www.Butlerautotrucksales.com.

I was trying to renew my passport and really thought it was a legitimate website, and I feel stupid for even falling for it, I
should know better.  I filled out the info and paid the fee and never heard back from them.  When I checked online for the
status, this was where I found I was scammed.  I find it harder to believe that this website is still up and running when it looks like the BBB knows about it and it's not shut down yet.  Will I be able to get my money back?  Is there something
more I can do to get this place shut down?  Can I file charges?

I purchased a dress from Donna's Dresses but realized within a few minutes that the company seemed like a scam. I emailed the support email address and asked for a cancellation within 20 minutes. The policy only stated that I was able to cancel my order within 4 hours, but they told me it had to be fulfilled. When I received the dress, it was poor quality, unlike the photo online. When I've emailed to request a refund, no one has responded to me.

Kathy Moore left two voicemails on 8/5/26 and 8/6/26 stating she was with LAKESIDE ASSOCIATES and that it was a civil complaint filed against me. They are going to go to an address I no longer live at and on an undisclosed date and time to serve me papers. I should call them back to discuss how I want to settle the matter. I googled the number and name of the company, but nothing of use was generated. I've received calls like this before.
